name: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
program: Call for projects (2026 session; environmental priorities, priority geographies)
collect_note: Reads the Foundation's own news feed (actualites, 1216 items, newest first; the adapter reads the newest 50) and keeps only call announcements (call for projects, proposals, entries, micro-initiatives, interest or expressions of interest), so new calls of the Foundation and its initiatives (Pelagos, DIMFE, BeMed, Human-Wildlife, OACIS, MedFund, Photography Award, partner calls such as the Commonwealth Blue Charter Incubator) surface twice a day with no agent. The program's own submit-a-project page only describes the 2026 session (online 1-30 June 2026, now closed; priorities: climate and renewables, biodiversity, water and desertification; priority geographies: Mediterranean, polar zones, LDCs), so it is not a dated list and cannot be collected as one. Feed items carry no deadline; the feed is the best plain-HTTP source (C4 step 2), and deadlines must be read from each call article.
